Article • 04/25/2025 • Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR
Updates properties of existing incident. Updatable properties are: status , determination ,
classification , assignedTo , tags , and comments .
1. You can make up to 50 calls per minute or 1,500 calls per hour before you hit the
throttling threshold.
2. You can set the determination  property only if classification  is set to TruePositive.
If your request is throttled, it returns a 429  response code. The response body indicates the
time when you can begin making new calls.
One of the following permissions is required to call this API. To learn more, including how to
choose permissions, see Access the Microsoft Defender XDR APIs.
Permission type
Permission
Permission display name
Application
Incident.ReadWrite.All
Read and write all incidents
